assumption: Failure of data provision is not provided on interface level.
rationale: SWS_Dcm_00793 specifies E_OK as the only return value ("this value is always returned"), whereas parameters for error codes such as ErrorCode only exist in asynchronous variants like SWS_Dcm_91005.
